Name: Lumisteria Wallpapers 2 - Custom Wall and Floor
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: New wallpapers and floors for Stardew Valley. This set include some wallpapers inspired by seasonal events.
Description:
This mod adds multiple new wallpapers and floors, some inspired by seasonal events.

All these walls and floors are in addition to the existing ones, they don't replace anything. You need to use [Custom Walls and Floors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010)https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/156109690059751424/636582214758301726/unknown.png)
Ready to receive friends for Spirits Eve.

Note that there are some issue with the Custom Walls and Floor mod, i can't do anything about them. In some cases, the wallpapers will
disappears and you have to put them again.
